say:1:1533501001:1.text: Hey, stop! Stop! You're drowning them!
say:1:1533501001:1.male: Hey, stop! Stop! You're drowning them!
say:1:1533501001:1.female: Hey, stop! Stop! You're drowning them!

say:2:1533501002:1.text: I just planted those seeds... finally managed to get them, and now you're going to kill them with all that water!
say:2:1533501002:1.source_cn: 我刚种下去的种子……好不容易才分到的种子……全都要被你...
say:2:1533501002:1.male: I just planted those seeds... finally managed to get them, and now you're going to kill them with all that water!
say:2:1533501002:1.female: I just planted those seeds... finally managed to get them, and now you're going to kill them with all that water!

say:3:1533501003:1.text: It's ruined... ruined! I'll never replant in time. My harvest... my food...
say:3:1533501003:1.source_cn: 怎么办……重新播种肯定来不及了，今年的粮食……我的粮食……

say:0:1533502001:0.text: Turns out they didn't need that much water... Oops.

say:1:1533503001:1.text: They're... they're alive! It's a miracle!

say:1:1533503001:1.male: They're... they're alive! It's a miracle!
say:1:1533503001:1.female: They're... they're alive! It's a miracle!

say:2:1533503002:0.text: And growing better than ever! No fertilizer needed at all!

say:2:1533503002:0.female: And growing better than ever! No fertilizer needed at all!

say:3:1533503003:0.text: I thought I was in for some bad luck, but it actually worked out for the best! Thank you!
